metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi\deff0{\fonttbl{\f0 \fswiss Helvetica;}}\f0\fs20 Larry Seyer Video Effects: video effects for REAPER's Video Processor with a control panel.\par \par Color grading with wheels and curves, titles, lower thirds, tutorial callouts, zoom to region, spotlight, transitions on crossfades, picture-in-picture, borders and shadows, looks, and a multicam switcher (lines the cameras up by their sound, then cut between camera tracks with the number keys or by clicking in the video window, with a transition per cut).\par \par Requires ReaImGui: install it from this same window (search 'ReaImGui') if you do not have it.\par \par IMPORTANT: after installing, open Actions > Show action list, search 'Larry Seyer Video Effects' and run it once. That adds the LS presets to the Video Processor preset list; until then they are not there.\par \par Manual: https://github.com/larryseyer/larry-seyer-video-effects/blob/main/Video/docs/MANUAL.md}

version.author: Larry Seyer
version.changelog: Multicam switcher: put camera tracks under a Multicam track and cut while it plays with the number keys, the Multicam window or a click on a camera in the Video window (switcher view shows every camera with the live one in red). Each cut can be a cut or one of 11 transitions (dissolves, dips, push, slide, split, squeeze). Cameras can start late or sit in any track order. New actions: Larry Seyer Video Effects - Multicam, and Multicam camera 1-9 (plus Shift versions) for the number keys.

version.author: Larry Seyer
version.changelog: Multicam: line the cameras up by their audio. The Multicam window's new Line up by audio section (and a setup option, on by default) moves every camera's clips to where their sound matches camera 1 or any reference track, to within a millisecond, in one undo step; clips that do not match stay put and are listed. Scripts: LS.multicam_sync.
